name: STAR Time — Earth Rotation Angle (IAU 2000) and GMST (IAU 2006)
summary: Earth Rotation Angle and IAU 2006 Greenwich Mean Sidereal Time from two-part Julian Dates over 1800-2200; reproduces the SOFA validation values to 1e-13 rad and agrees with ERFA and Skyfield within 4e-8 arcsec.
reference_observed: ERA equal to the published value to the last double digit; GMST within 4e-15 rad

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: degrees out; two-part Julian Dates in (UT1 for the rotation, TT for the polynomial), stated in docstring and README
review.G-06: no external data; constants of the IERS Conventions pinned in the tests
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for invalid input and for dates outside 1800-2200; no iteration, no extrapolation
